name: amfx-sp500-thanksgiving-research
description: amFX reproduction (23NOV22 p1): S&P 500 daily returns around Thanksgiving holiday. Shows returns for t-1 (Wed), t+1 (Fri), t+2 (Mon), t+3 (Tue) relative to Thanksgiving Thursday. Black Friday (t+1) is notably weak: 38% hit rate, -0.3% median.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: S&P THANKSGIVING SEASONALITY (23NOV22 p1)
# =============================================================================
# S&P 500 daily returns around Thanksgiving.
# day_of_week uses UTC so actual trading days map correctly.
# Wednesday before Thanksgiving = 4th week of Nov + Wednesday
# Black Friday = 4th week of Nov + Friday
# Monday/Tuesday after = last week of Nov (or first week Dec) + Mon/Tue
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ret_pct = returns(period=1)(close) * 100.0

# Index and year extraction
idx = index()
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(idx)
dom = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day)(idx)

# Calendar flags
is_nov = month_of_year(month=Month.November)()
is_dec = month_of_year(month=Month.December)()
is_4th_week = week_of_month(week=WeekOfMonth.Fourth)()
is_last_week = week_of_month(week=WeekOfMonth.Last)()
is_1st_week = week_of_month(week=WeekOfMonth.First)()
is_wed = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Wednesday)()
is_fri = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Friday)()
is_mon = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Monday)()
is_tue = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Tuesday)()

# Thanksgiving Wednesday: November + 4th week + Wednesday
thanks_wed = is_nov and is_4th_week and is_wed

# Black Friday: November + 4th week + Friday
thanks_fri = is_nov and is_4th_week and is_fri


# Monday after Thanksgiving: must be Nov 25-30 or Dec 1-4
# In UTC dates, these correspond to the Monday after 4th Thu
thanks_mon_nov = is_nov and is_mon and (dom >= 25.0) and (dom <= 30.0)
thanks_mon_dec = is_dec and is_mon and (dom >= 1.0) and (dom <= 4.0)
thanks_mon = thanks_mon_nov or thanks_mon_dec

# Tuesday after Thanksgiving: must be Nov 26-30 or Dec 1-5
thanks_tue_nov = is_nov and is_tue and (dom >= 26.0) and (dom <= 30.0)
thanks_tue_dec = is_dec and is_tue and (dom >= 1.0) and (dom <= 5.0)
thanks_tue = thanks_tue_nov or thanks_tue_dec

# Extract returns, NaN for non-Thanksgiving days
wed_ret = ret_pct if thanks_wed else 0.0 / 0.0
fri_ret = ret_pct if thanks_fri else 0.0 / 0.0
mon_ret = ret_pct if thanks_mon else 0.0 / 0.0
tue_ret = ret_pct if thanks_tue else 0.0 / 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Scatter of Individual Year Returns
# =============================================================================
xy_scatter(
    title='S&P 500 Returns Around Thanksgiving by Year',
    category='Thanksgiving Seasonality',
    y_axis_label='Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='t-1 Wednesday', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='t+1 Black Friday', color=Color.Red, marker=MarkerSymbol.SquareMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='t+2 Monday', color=Color.Gray, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker),
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='t+3 Tuesday', color=Color.Sky, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x=year_num, y_values=(wed_ret, fri_ret, mon_ret, tue_ret))
